summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Morning. A clean StarTrust participation table sits in the bullpen beneath a cheerful placard. Middle image: Kreeb places a stack of simple local cards beside the corporate tablet. Closing image: Zib looks at the table.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Morning. A clean StarTrust participation table sits in the bullpen beneath a cheerful placard.
PANEL 2 — Astra addresses the crew with the expression of someone delivering a corporate briefing she does not believe in.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb places a stack of simple local cards beside the corporate tablet.
PANEL 4 — Glorp checks the cards against the approved Wellness Week procedure.
PANEL 5 — Zib looks at the table.

dialogueInline.speaker: SIGN
dialogueInline.text: BRING YOUR FEELINGS TO WORK DAY / PARTICIPATION REQUIRED / DISCLOSURE OPTIONAL.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: You must participate. You do not have to disclose anything.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: Can I disclose that the table is in my way?

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Jax sits at the participation table with his card. Middle image: Jax hands the card to Glorp. Closing image: Jax looks mildly pleased.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Jax sits at the participation table with his card.
PANEL 2 — He checks the no-entry disclosure state.
PANEL 3 — Pixa scans it.
PANEL 4 — Jax hands the card to Glorp.
PANEL 5 — Noola passes behind him and glances at the card.
PANEL 6 — Jax looks mildly pleased.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIXA
dialogueInline.text: Participation complete. Disclosure state: no entry.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: I feel extremely compliant about this.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: Best review I've had all year.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Another employee uses the free-text field instead of choosing an emotion category. Middle image: Kreeb reads it over Zib's shoulder. Closing image: Zib is already walking away with the card.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Another employee uses the free-text field instead of choosing an emotion category.
PANEL 2 — Glorp reads it.
PANEL 3 — Zib takes the card from them.
PANEL 4 — Kreeb reads it over Zib's shoulder.
PANEL 5 — Glorp points at the form.
PANEL 6 — Zib is already walking away with the card.

dialogueInline.speaker: SIGN
dialogueInline.text: VENT BY BERTH 3 WHISTLES ALL NIGHT.

dialogueInline.speaker: KREEB
dialogueInline.text: It may also explain why someone is tired.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: The program asks for disclosure context.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: Context is vent by berth three.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: More cards accumulate: stool 4 wobbles; east hatch sticks when cold; night shift handoff has two different checklists; printer beeps after it prints. Middle image: Kreeb finds a separate handwritten card: I MISS HOME ON LATE SHIFT. Closing image: Across the room Noola notices Kreeb holding it, then looks away without being identified publicly.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — More cards accumulate: stool 4 wobbles; east hatch sticks when cold; night shift handoff has two different checklists; printer beeps after it prints.
PANEL 2 — Pixa scans the submissions and reports that most contain equipment or process nouns.
PANEL 3 — Mira approves of the bounded observation rather than an emotional inference.
PANEL 4 — Kreeb finds a separate handwritten card: I MISS HOME ON LATE SHIFT.
PANEL 5 — Astra looks from the repairable complaints to the personal card.
PANEL 6 — Across the room Noola notices Kreeb holding it, then looks away without being identified publicly.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIXA
dialogueInline.text: Seventy-one percent of free-text entries contain equipment or process nouns.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: Useful. Do not make up the other twenty-nine percent.

dialogueInline.speaker: SIGN
dialogueInline.text: I MISS HOME ON LATE SHIFT.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: That one is not a maintenance ticket.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: The corporate participation dashboard updates with low emotion-category completion. Middle image: Pixa answers immediately. Closing image: Glorp studies the warning; Kreeb answers.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The corporate participation dashboard updates with low emotion-category completion.
PANEL 2 — A warning appears.
PANEL 3 — Astra points at it.
PANEL 4 — Pixa answers immediately.
PANEL 5 — Mira approves.
PANEL 6 — Glorp studies the warning; Kreeb answers.

dialogueInline.speaker: SCREEN
dialogueInline.text: LOW CATEGORY COMPLETION MAY LIMIT INTERPRETABILITY.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Pixa, do not infer the missing categories.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: The system dislikes being told less than it asked.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Glorp and Kreeb sort the stack into four trays: ENTRY / NO ENTRY / WORKPLACE DEFECT / PERSONAL. Middle image: Then Kreeb holds the I MISS HOME card over PERSONAL and does not translate it into a category beyond what was written. Closing image: He accepts both trays into the local workflow without copying personal text into the corporate dashboard.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Glorp and Kreeb sort the stack into four trays: ENTRY / NO ENTRY / WORKPLACE DEFECT / PERSONAL.
PANEL 2 — Glorp hesitates over WORKPLACE DEFECT because the initiative does not define it as disclosure.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb holds up the noisy-vent card and points to the work-order tray.
PANEL 4 — Then Kreeb holds the I MISS HOME card over PERSONAL and does not translate it into a category beyond what was written.
PANEL 5 — Glorp considers the distinction.
PANEL 6 — He accepts both trays into the local workflow without copying personal text into the corporate dashboard.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: The initiative does not define workplace defect as disclosure.

dialogueInline.speaker: KREEB
dialogueInline.text: Someone chose to tell us what was making work worse.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Brick is standing beside the anonymous drop box because he has nowhere else to stand without blocking traffic. Middle image: Soon Brick is holding several anonymous notes like evidence. Closing image: Brick looks down at the box, then the notes.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Brick is standing beside the anonymous drop box because he has nowhere else to stand without blocking traffic.
PANEL 2 — A worker approaches, sees Brick, and hands him a folded note instead of putting it in the slot.
PANEL 3 — Another person does the same thing.
PANEL 4 — Soon Brick is holding several anonymous notes like evidence.
PANEL 5 — Jax passes.
PANEL 6 — Brick looks down at the box, then the notes.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Zib has converted ten concrete complaints into ordinary maintenance tickets. Middle image: Kreeb keeps the I MISS HOME card separate from Zib's tickets. Closing image: Astra nods toward Kreeb, accepting the boundary before turning back to the repair list.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Zib has converted ten concrete complaints into ordinary maintenance tickets.
PANEL 2 — Astra reads the list and starts pairing real defects with owners.
PANEL 3 — One anonymous note still reads: THE VENDING MACHINE IS SMUG. Brick silently keeps it near the top.
PANEL 4 — Kreeb keeps the I MISS HOME card separate from Zib's tickets.
PANEL 5 — Zib looks at the separate card and does not reach for it.
PANEL 6 — Astra nods toward Kreeb, accepting the boundary before turning back to the repair list.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: Ten jobs. One opinion about vending.

dialogueInline.speaker: KREEB
dialogueInline.text: And one thing that is not a job.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Then do not make it one.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Quiet Room. Opening image: In the quiet room from Wellness Week, Kreeb is returning the unused personal-disclosure cards to a locked local envelope. Middle image: Noola settles in her water-dome rig beside the ordinary chair; there is no screen, form, or task list between them. Closing image: They sit for a quiet beat. Nothing is resolved because nothing was presented as a defect.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — In the quiet room from Wellness Week, Kreeb is returning the unused personal-disclosure cards to a locked local envelope.
PANEL 2 — Noola enters and points to the I MISS HOME ON LATE SHIFT card.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb looks at Noola rather than at the card.
PANEL 4 — Noola settles in her water-dome rig beside the ordinary chair; there is no screen, form, or task list between them.
PANEL 5 — Kreeb asks one practical question and accepts the answer.
PANEL 6 — They sit for a quiet beat. Nothing is resolved because nothing was presented as a defect.

dialogueInline.speaker: NOOLA
dialogueInline.text: No. I miss home. That's all.

dialogueInline.speaker: KREEB
dialogueInline.text: You did not ask for a fix.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in East hatch service area in Stardust Station's maintained corridor network. Opening image: Elsewhere on the station, Jax and Mira take the east-hatch ticket Astra assigned from the repair queue. The hatch moves cleanly at room temperature. Middle image: Mira cools the local test strip. The hatch starts binding. Closing image: Mira looks at him.
settingText: East hatch service area in Stardust Station's maintained corridor network; ordinary access hardware, thermal history display, guide track and safe local test area.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Elsewhere on the station, Jax and Mira take the east-hatch ticket Astra assigned from the repair queue. The hatch moves cleanly at room temperature.
PANEL 2 — Mira checks the thermal history.
PANEL 3 — Jax inspects the lower guide.
PANEL 4 — Mira cools the local test strip. The hatch starts binding.
PANEL 5 — Jax points to the guide.
PANEL 6 — Mira looks at him.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: Then this is pretending to be innocent.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: You found it before the graph.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: Please keep that off my permanent record.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Montage of actual fixes, each character-sized rather than heroic. Middle image: Glorp and Kreeb reconcile the two night-shift handoff checklists into one page. Closing image: Noola passes Kreeb in the working bullpen. They exchange a small ordinary acknowledgment; neither of them marks anything complete.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Montage of actual fixes, each character-sized rather than heroic.
PANEL 2 — Zib adjusts the whistling vent.
PANEL 3 — Jax and Mira shim the east-hatch guide.
PANEL 4 — Glorp and Kreeb reconcile the two night-shift handoff checklists into one page.
PANEL 5 — Pixa counts only the operational results: defects and process conflicts closed.
PANEL 6 — Noola passes Kreeb in the working bullpen. They exchange a small ordinary acknowledgment; neither of them marks anything complete.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: This is the best feelings day I've ever seen.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Lab Work Area. Opening image: Later, Mira reviews passive samples collected during the day. Middle image: Mira shakes her head. Closing image: Zib walks past; Mira answers Astra with the operational result.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Later, Mira reviews passive samples collected during the day.
PANEL 2 — Pixa shows physical-only totals.
PANEL 3 — Astra looks at Mira.
PANEL 4 — Mira shakes her head.
PANEL 5 — Mira closes the sample case.
PANEL 6 — Zib walks past; Mira answers Astra with the operational result.

dialogueInline.speaker: PIXA
dialogueInline.text: Passive sample mass is lower than yesterday.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: Did the fixes help the station?

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Resource Efficiency Review sends a follow-up request. Middle image: Mira points at the output-correlation request. Closing image: Astra nods.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Resource Efficiency Review sends a follow-up request.
PANEL 2 — Astra reads it aloud.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb closes the local personal-disclosure envelope before answering.
PANEL 4 — Mira points at the output-correlation request.
PANEL 5 — Glorp studies the forms and identifies the aggregate operational information they can legitimately provide.
PANEL 6 — Astra nods.

dialogueInline.speaker: SCREEN
dialogueInline.text: REQUEST: DE-IDENTIFIED DISCLOSURE THEMES / OUTPUT CORRELATION.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: We can provide aggregate maintenance themes and completion states.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Glorp builds the aggregate report with facility irritants, process irritants, no-entry, and indeterminate material effect. The personal card remains in the locked local envelope and is absent from the report. Middle image: Glorp changes the description. Closing image: Brick, still holding one folded vending-machine note, watches the report leave individual language behind.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Glorp builds the aggregate report with facility irritants, process irritants, no-entry, and indeterminate material effect. The personal card remains in the locked local envelope and is absent from the report.
PANEL 2 — Glorp points to NO ENTRY.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb answers immediately.
PANEL 4 — Glorp changes the description.
PANEL 5 — Kreeb checks the outgoing report once more; there is no personal-disclosure category or count.
PANEL 6 — Brick, still holding one folded vending-machine note, watches the report leave individual language behind.

dialogueInline.speaker: SCREEN
dialogueInline.text: FACILITY IRRITANTS / PROCESS IRRITANTS / NO ENTRY / MATERIAL EFFECT: INDETERMINATE.

dialogueInline.speaker: GLORP
dialogueInline.text: Do I classify this as nonresponse?

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Pixa posts the day's passive collection total. Middle image: Mira does not speculate. Closing image: Mira looks at Astra.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Pixa posts the day's passive collection total.
PANEL 2 — The number is lower than the previous two workdays.
PANEL 3 — Astra looks at Mira.
PANEL 4 — Mira does not speculate.
PANEL 5 — Zib rolls a repaired stool past them.
PANEL 6 — Mira looks at Astra.

dialogueInline.speaker: ZIB
dialogueInline.text: We spent the day fixing things.

dialogueInline.speaker: MIRA
dialogueInline.text: Also true. Not the same as causation.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Astra writes the summary herself. Middle image: Mira reads it. Closing image: Astra sends it.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra writes the summary herself.
PANEL 2 — The display states that workplace-defect reports were routed to ordinary work and that individual disclosure content is outside this report.
PANEL 3 — The display states the operational benefit and indeterminate material effect.
PANEL 4 — Mira reads it.
PANEL 5 — Glorp reads it.
PANEL 6 — Astra sends it.

dialogueInline.speaker: SCREEN
dialogueInline.text: Workplace-defect disclosures were routed to ordinary maintenance and process work. Individual disclosure content is outside this report.

dialogueInline.speaker: SCREEN
dialogueInline.text: Operational benefit observed. Material-output effect indeterminate.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: I am getting better at disappointing forms.

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Corporate response appears. Middle image: Second line recommends an on-site operations liaison. Closing image: Astra keeps reading.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Corporate response appears.
PANEL 2 — First line reports remote interpretation as inconclusive.
PANEL 3 — Second line recommends an on-site operations liaison.
PANEL 4 — Jax reads the message.
PANEL 5 — Astra keeps reading.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Apparently we have become too confusing for email.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Astra opens the visit-preparation list. Middle image: Astra looks at him. Closing image: Pixa records the accepted route owner.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra opens the visit-preparation list.
PANEL 2 — Before she assigns anything, Jax looks at the route section.
PANEL 3 — Jax takes the visitor-route responsibility.
PANEL 4 — Astra looks at him.
PANEL 5 — Jax picks up the route slate.
PANEL 6 — Pixa records the accepted route owner.

dialogueInline.speaker: JAX
dialogueInline.text: Fine. I own the visitor route.

dialogueInline.speaker: SCREEN
dialogueInline.text: VISITOR ROUTE OWNER: JAX ORIEN — ACCEPTED.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Astra begins a familiar pre-visit checklist. Middle image: Astra deletes the performative items. Closing image: Astra addresses the crew. Zib looks around.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra begins a familiar pre-visit checklist.
PANEL 2 — She stops at PRESENTATION.
PANEL 3 — She looks around at the ordinary working station.
PANEL 4 — Astra deletes the performative items.
PANEL 5 — The new list contains only safety hazards, access, and required records.
PANEL 6 — Astra addresses the crew. Zib looks around.

dialogueInline.speaker: SCREEN
dialogueInline.text: PRESENTATION / SIGNAGE / VISIBLE CLUTTER / STAFF READINESS.

dialogueInline.speaker: ASTRA
dialogueInline.text: Do not stage anything. Clean safety hazards. Leave the station.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: The anonymous and personal disclosure cards remain locked locally. They are not added to the visitor packet. Middle image: Mira includes the bounded material result. Closing image: Close on the note. Brick folds it again.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The anonymous and personal disclosure cards remain locked locally. They are not added to the visitor packet.
PANEL 2 — Glorp includes only aggregate operational categories and completion counts.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb checks that NO ENTRY remains visible as a valid aggregate category and that no personal-disclosure category, count, or text appears.
PANEL 4 — Mira includes the bounded material result.
PANEL 5 — Brick is still holding the one vending-machine note he never returned.
PANEL 6 — Close on the note. Brick folds it again.

summary: Primary composition: 6-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Pixa displays the confirmed StarTrust operations liaison visit. Middle image: He moves it to the approved rack and checks access clearance. Closing image: Jax checks the box.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Pixa displays the confirmed StarTrust operations liaison visit.
PANEL 2 — Jax walks the visitor route with a checklist.
PANEL 3 — He finds a collection bin partly encroaching on the path.
PANEL 4 — He moves it to the approved rack and checks access clearance.
PANEL 5 — Astra passes him.
PANEL 6 — Jax checks the box.

summary: Primary composition: 5-panel page in Main Bullpen / Admin Hub. Opening image: Late cycle. Brick stands alone at the vending machine. Middle image: The machine dispenses a protein bar and prints an optimization receipt. Closing image: Pixa glides past. Brick keeps staring at the vending machine.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Late cycle. Brick stands alone at the vending machine.
PANEL 2 — He selects water.
PANEL 3 — The machine dispenses a protein bar and prints an optimization receipt.
PANEL 4 — Brick studies the receipt.
PANEL 5 — Pixa glides past. Brick keeps staring at the vending machine.
